# Historical legacy schema fixtures (test-only)

These SQL files are **historical snapshots used only to recognize old databases
and to test the read-only classifier**. They are NOT a schema authority and are
never executed by the application, the migration tooling or deployment.

Authority: `../../migrations/0001..0013` (frozen; see `migrations/MIGRATIONS.lock`).
Generated schema: `../../schema.sql` (DO NOT EDIT; generated by
`scripts/gen-schema-snapshot.mjs`).
